en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a grand waterside castle reflected in a calm lake. The building has four large round corner towers with domed roofs and lanterns, steep central roofs with small spires, and a formal garden and tree‑lined terrace along the water. Two small pavilion buildings flank the lakeshore in front of the castle. Forested hills are visible in the background. No printed caption or other text is visible on the image.
